name: Pinned Comment Lines
brief: Pin comment lines so they surface as a notification when the record is used.
description: Extends the standard Business Central comment sheet with a Pinned flag, an optional expiry date, and a severity. Pinned comments raise a single aggregated notification when a customer, vendor, or item card is opened, and when the record is selected on a sales or purchase document. The notification is controlled from the user's own My Notifications settings.
